map.铣削进给 f = v_c/(π·d·n): Milling feed f = v_c/(pi x d x n)
map.💡 转速 n = 1000×Vc/(π×D)；进给速度 Vf = n×Z×fz。: Tip: Spindle speed n = 1000 x Vc/(pi x D); feed rate Vf = n x Z x fz. Recommended Vc varies by material.
map.计算结果为理论值，实际加工需结合机床刚性、刀具磨损、冷却等调整: Results are theoretical; actual machining needs adjustment for machine rigidity, tool wear, cooling, etc.
map.📚 深度解析：切削加工转速与进给计算: 📚 In-depth: Cutting Speed and Feed Calculation
map.车/铣设定主轴转速 n 与进给速度 Vf，匹配刀具与材料。: Set spindle speed n and feed rate Vf for turning/milling, matching tool and material.
map.vc、刀径 dia、齿数 z、每齿进给 fz，求工艺参数。: vc, cutter diameter dia, teeth z, feed per tooth fz, find process parameters.
map.校核每转进给 f 避免积屑瘤。: Check feed per revolution f to avoid built-up edge.
map.硬质合金铣刀 dia=20mm、z=4、vc=120m/min、fz=0.1mm: Carbide end mill dia=20mm, z=4, vc=120m/min, fz=0.1mm: n = 1000 x 120/(pi x 20) ~ 1910 rpm, Vf = 1910 x 4 x 0.1 = 764 mm/min, f = 4 x 0.1 = 0.4 mm/rev.
map.若 vc 降至 80m/min、dia 不变：n = 1000×80÷(π×20: If vc drops to 80m/min with same dia: n = 1000 x 80/(pi x 20) ~ 1273 rpm, Vf drops by nearly 1/3 proportionally, suitable for hard-to-machine materials like stainless steel.
map.取决于刀具材质与工件：高速钢 20–40、硬质合金 80–200、陶瓷/立方氮化: Depends on tool material and workpiece: HSS 20-40, carbide 80-200, ceramic/cubic boron nitride higher; for hard materials take the lower end and cool adequately.
map.每齿进给 fz 过大怎样？: What if feed per tooth fz is too large?
map.fz 过大会崩刃、表面粗糙度差；过小易积屑瘤。一般合金钢 fz=0.05–0.1: Too-large fz chips the edge and worsens surface finish; too small tends to built-up edge. For alloy steel fz=0.05-0.15mm, depending on machine rigidity.
